references.meaning: Continuous east-west corridor, western diagonal approach, three north viewing bays, eastern escalators. Schematic, not metric.
Dated 2014 corridor: dark floor, glazed screens, handrails, south low wall and vents.
Dated 2014 viewing bay reaches inclined exterior glazing with guard rails and information panels.

limits: West bridge endpoint and roof axes come from municipal geometry; extending the bridge to the main roof boundary is an explicit geometric construction hypothesis, not a source floor measurement.
Central corridor floor is not present as a verified continuous source surface. Finished-floor datum, corridor width, eastern landing, screen heights, bay dimensions and locations remain provisional.
Bay count and north-side placement are operator-map evidence; approximate relative spacing is taken from a schematic. Absolute dimensions cannot be inferred from that map.
Bay intrusion into the unmodified inner roof must be audited. Roof framing, support bearings, suspended hangers, viewing information panels and eastern escalators are unfinished.
No source photograph is embedded as a game texture. No public route, gameplay or performance acceptance is implied.
The western approach continues the provisional arched bridge enclosure to the main-corridor miter. Its 0.55m rise and 32-segment curve are authoring assumptions.

Bay guard projection was reduced from 3.8m to 3.4m after exact triangle/clearance-volume checks found the larger footprint intersected the registered outer glazing. Bay width and all three bays are preserved; final photo registration remains required.
